gap: No result ChatGPT got says that the 1,300–1,700 lm flat lights all drop to roughly 400–500 lm within about a minute, or that at that level the Olight ArkPro then ran 2 h 26 min on 1lumen's bench (453 lm at 10 min), against about 100 min at ~400 lm for the Wuben X5 (BLF tester roma58) and 1 h 02 min for the Wurkkos HD01 Pro (1lumen, 428 lm at 10 min).
standout_why: I compared against the pages ChatGPT cited and the answers it gave. Popular Mechanics' ArkPro Ultra review, the Yahoo Tech test and the Lowe's Klein listing all returned 403 to me, so I could not check their text; how they compare is unverified. Our own current page (dealectric.com, opened 2026-11-08) gives '~400 lm sustained' for the X5 and '1,023 lm measured' and '975 mW UV measured' for the HD01 Pro, but names nobody who measured them. It has no ArkPro runtime and no measured sustained output for the ArkPro. All three ChatGPT answers list only advertised peak lumens. One adds 'Lumens are advertised peak outputs, not sustained brightness' but gives no sustained figure for any light.
decides: This confirms the Olight ArkPro (or ArkPro Ultra) as the pick over the Wuben X5 and Wurkkos HD01 Pro for long use. All three hold about the same 400–500 lm after step-down, but the ArkPro holds it the longest (2 h 26 min vs about 100 min vs 1 h 02 min). Its 1,500 lm peak also measured closest to its claim (1,372 lm at 30 s, against 814 lm for the X5 from ZeroAir). The HD01 Pro is the one to take if you care about the laser: 1lumen measured its laser brighter than Olight's Arkfeld Pro/Ultra (9 vs 5 lux, measured indirectly).

findings.label: Flood Turbo output: turn-on / 30 s / 10 min
findings.note: 1lumen (reviewer Nick) measured it. Output stays above 1,000 lm for about 2 min, then holds about 450 lm for about 2 h before stepping down.

findings.label: Flood Turbo runtime
findings.value: 2 h 26 min to ANSI FL1 end point; 2 h 41 min to shutoff (claim 2 h 23 min)

findings.label: Spot Turbo peak intensity / throw at 30 s
findings.note: Measured with a Testo 545. The reviewer later found the meter reads 21% low, which would put it near 10,190 cd. The throw figure was not corrected.

findings.label: Charge time / CRI
findings.value: a little over 90 min (1,949 mAh added, about 8 W on USB-C); CRI Ra 71.5 on Flood High, 64.4 on Spot High
findings.note: CRI measured with an Opple Lightmaster Pro at 1 m. 1lumen measured no laser or UV power.

findings.label: Flood Turbo output: 0 s / 30 s
findings.source_title: ZeroAir: Olight ArkPro Ultra flat EDC flashlight review (2025-11-19)
findings.note: ZeroAir measured it. At 30 s that is 80.6% of the claim. The spot measured 11,051 cd, which works out to 210 m (lux at 5.148 m).

findings.label: Flood Turbo sustained output and duration
findings.value: 1,738 lm at turn-on, 1,658 lm at 30 s, then just over 500 lm for about 75 min before the next drop
findings.source_title: The Technology Man: ArkPro Ultra review (Gidon, 2025-11-19)
findings.note: Measured in a DIY lumen chamber. The same review measured the spot at 7,408 cd / 172 m, which conflicts with ZeroAir's 11,051 cd. Also: about 1 h 34 min USB-C charge, CRI 67, 123 g.

findings.label: Turbo output: 0 s / 30 s and throw
findings.source_title: ZeroAir: Wuben X5 3-in-1 compact EDC flashlight review (2026-06-15)
findings.note: ZeroAir measured it, on the included 1,200 mAh pack. At 30 s that is 62.6% of the claim. High measured 319 lm at 30 s. CCT 4,700–4,800 K.

findings.label: Turbo sustained output and runtime
findings.value: about 400 lm after the first minute, held for about 100 min, then shutoff; High (350 lm) ran just over 2 h
findings.note: Tested indoors at about 24 °C on the 1,200 mAh pack (3R laser version). The same tester measured about 4,000 cd peak, a 1 h 20 min charge, Ra about 65, and 128 g.

findings.label: Turbo output (second tester)
findings.note: The tester used hobby-grade equipment and says so. This conflicts with ZeroAir's 1,071 lm at 0 s. Weighed 129 g with battery.

findings.label: Turbo output: turn-on / 30 s / 10 min and runtime

findings.note: 1lumen (reviewer Rob) measured it. Turbo throw 5,251 cd / 145 m (claim 6,175 cd / 157 m). Charged in 1 h 27 min. Weighed 97 g with battery.

findings.label: Laser brightness vs Olight Arkfeld Pro/Ultra; UV output
findings.value: 9 lux vs 5 lux (indirect light in an integrating sphere); UV 975 mW at 365 nm, runtime 4 h 22 min
findings.note: A relative reading, not laser power in mW. The comparison lights are Arkfeld models, not the ArkPro. The UV LED has no ZWB filter.
